subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` check threshold for security-audit automation?
rationale: The code is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be ignored by CI/operator gates is a security and product policy choice.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR for now and invite a secops/core owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the new public CLI contract as an opt-in gate because the default remains `info` and the PR includes docs, tests, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-approved variant, such as limiting the threshold to specific finding classes or folding it into a broader audit/doctor policy.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR for now and invite a secops/core owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.
